summary: ansible-core 2.19 deprecations: --inventory-file alias, non-boolean test results, warnings/deprecations keys in exit_json, third-party strategy plugins, ShellModule.checksum, collections.count, !!omap/!!pairs and !vault-encrypted YAML tags, importlib_resources and datetime compat shims, and bool coercion.
questions: Can I keep using third-party strategy plugins like Mitogen?
How should a module emit warnings instead of the warnings key?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.19 deprecations (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- CLI `--inventory-file` alias → use `-i` / `--inventory`.
- Jinja tests returning non-booleans are deprecated.
- `warnings`/`deprecations` keys in `exit_json`/`fail_json` → use `AnsibleModule.warn` / `AnsibleModule.deprecate`.
- **Strategy plugins** outside `ansible.builtin` are deprecated with no compatibility guarantees; external strategies will be removed and no alternative is planned.
- `ShellModule.checksum` → `ActionBase._execute_remote_stat()` (removed in 2.23).
- `common.collections.count()` → `collections.Counter()` (2.23).
- YAML `!!omap`/`!!pairs` → standard mappings; `!vault-encrypted` → `!vault`.
- `ansible.compat.importlib_resources` → `importlib.resources` (2.23).
- `module_utils.compat.datetime` shims (`UTC`, `utcfromtimestamp()`, `utcnow`) removed in 2.21.
- `bool` filter coercion of unrecognized values deprecated.
